title: Öfke Büyürse Patlar Mı?
author: Elif Bahar
description: Ömer struggles with anger after being hurt and excluded by his friends. His rage pushes him further into loneliness until a magical encounter with a wise old cedar tree and a fairy girl changes his path. With their guidance, he learns the power of “I’m sorry” and “Thank you” and discovers healthier ways to express himself through kindness, friendship, and poetry. The story helps children recognize, understand, and transform anger into connection and growth.
